robots_note: ckan.govdata.de robots.txt is a blanket Disallow: / for User-agent *. Public reuse API; honour 10s crawl-delay spirit, descriptive UA, low rate. Note in methodology.
notes: CKAN + ckanext-dcat + DCAT-AP.de (dcatde). Catalogue RDF at /catalog.{rdf,ttl,jsonld}?page=N, 100/page, Hydra PagedCollection. Loop until a page has no dcat:Dataset. Licence is a URI at the DISTRIBUTION level (resources[].license / dct:license on dcat:Distribution), e.g. http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/...; dataset-level license_id is almost always empty, do NOT use it. Some German free-text licence values appear. data.europa.eu not needed.
